label: Dell OptiPlex 7010 Plus small form factor
description: Small-form-factor business desktop, 13th-gen Core, one 1GbE RJ45 on the rear panel, 180W internal PSU.
notes: 1GbE Intel I219-LM RJ45 is standard on every SFF configuration - no dongle. No Wi-Fi unless the optional M.2 wireless card is ordered, so model this node as wired-only.
